## Conclusions
- **Final FP32 head to head of the fine-tuned students** (all trained with the identical 010 recipe), paired
  against fine-tuned B:
  - S3 FT: 88.01, **+0.73 [-0.3, +1.8]** (not significant); per fold 90.4 / 87.9 / 87.6 / 87.3 / 86.8 vs. B's
    87.7 / 86.5 / 88.3 / 87.0 / 87.0, so S3 wins on 3 of 5 folds.
  - S0 FT: 82.26, -5.02 [-6.3, -3.7] (significant).
  - Official baseline (CLIP ViT-B/16 as shipped): 63.19, **-24.09** [-26.0, -22.1].
- **On the real LPCVC sample, fine-tuned B beats the official baseline by +4.02 [+1.6, +6.9]** (paired, 56 images):
  91.37 vs 87.35. This is our cleanest evidence on the actual competition distribution. S3 FT is +1.49 [-0.4, +3.7] over
  B FT on the sample (not significant).
- These FP32 numbers are the ones to quote in the report; they match the on-device results (fidelity ≥ 0.9998).
